name: triage
description: Classify an incoming request and decide how much machinery it deserves. Ask before any expensive work.
policy: intent=chat (conf>=0.55) -> chat_only. intent=lookup -> run_deterministic. intent=account -> ask_human. complexity=heavy -> consider research_capped or allow_subagent via needs_subagent noul.

complexity.instructions: How much agent effort is justified for this request?

intent.instructions: What kind of work does this request mainly need?

criteria.account: Send, publish, pay, delete, or change permissions
criteria.chat: Short answer or conversation; no tools needed
criteria.coding: Edit code, tests, or repo work
criteria.lookup: Known file, API, or status check; mostly deterministic
criteria.write: Draft long prose, email, or document

needs_tools_at_all.instructions: Can this be answered well with no tools at all (pure knowledge / conversation)?

criteria.yes: Can this be answered well with no tools at all (pure knowledge / conversation)?
